newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-MANTILLA HITS BACK TO REACH MARBELLA SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MANTILLA HITS BACK TO REACH MARBELLA SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Spain's Felix Mantilla staged an outstanding fightback to beat Norway's Christian Ruud for a semifinal place in the Marbella world series men's tennis tournament on Friday.
Mantilla now faces German Marc Goellner, and the other semifinal will also pit a Spaniard, fourth seed Alex Corretja, against an unfancied German, Bernd Karbacher.

Second seed Mantilla was staring defeat in the face after crashing 6-0 in the first set, and losing his serve to go 6-5 down in the second. But Mantilla broke back, then took the tiebreak 7-2 before running out a 6-3 winner in the final set.
Mantilla will be hoping not to become Goellner's fourth successive Spanish victim after the German player dispatched qualifier Fernando Vicente 7-5 6-1.
Corretja beat Uruguyuan qualifier Marcelo Filippini by the same score, while Karbacher outlasted Spain's Marcos Aurelio Gorriz to win 6-3 2-6 6-4 in nearly two hours.
